title: The Machine Learning Trap That Wastes Months
description:
Most people trying to learn machine learning fall into the same trap: learning everything before building anything. Months on linear algebra proofs, never training a single model.

The fix: learn just enough theory to know what's happening, then build immediately. You learn faster shipping projects than memorizing proofs. Fail building something first — theory comes easier later.

#techwithtim   #machinelearning #softwareengineering #programming
